questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring branding and corporate identity. Annotate your process.

points.text: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to branding and corporate identity, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with branding and corporate identity. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.

points.text: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with branding and corporate identity. Which approaches were most successful and why?

points.text: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Create a complete brand identity for a fictional company. Design the logo, choose colours and typography, and apply the identity across at least three different media. Include brand guidelines documentation. <div class="

points.text: A grade 9 response will: design a simple, scalable, memorable logo; define clear brand guidelines; apply the identity consistently across media; annotate every decision with rationale; show the logo working at different scales and in monochrome. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
